subject.title: feat: serve signed catalog feed change pages

question: Should the existing `/api/v1/feeds/plugins` route switch immediately to fail-closed DSSE responses with this change-page rollout, or should ClawHub preserve the unsigned representation until a coordinated versioned cutover is proven with the OpenClaw trust root?
rationale: This choice defines a public compatibility, availability, signing-secret, and client-trust boundary that cannot be resolved from tests alone and was explicitly deferred by the original hosted-feed contract.

options.title: Stage A Compatible Cutover
options.body: Keep the existing representation available while the signed snapshot and change contract, OpenClaw public key, rotation plan, and live upgrade proof land together.

options.title: Approve Immediate Fail-Closed Cutover
options.body: Allow the existing route to become signed and unavailable without valid signer configuration, with maintainers explicitly owning the deployment and compatibility impact.

options.title: Pause The Transport Stack
options.body: Leave this draft parked until the prerequisite PRs and cross-repository consumer contract are settled.

recommendation.title: Stage A Compatible Cutover
recommendation.body: Keep the existing representation available while the signed snapshot and change contract, OpenClaw public key, rotation plan, and live upgrade proof land together.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the existing hosted-feed trust and storage contract that this PR changes.
